title: Core log line
description: One line of <store>/core/log.jsonl, the shared core log (docs/brain-memory.md, phase 6; docs/memory-v2.md, "The core log"): append-only, written by one writer at a time under <store>/core/log.lock, members in this order, text redacted. A line that does not decode is skipped, but the generation it began with and the log's line count bound the next generation from below, so a torn line's generation is never used again. Source: memory/core/log.go (Line, Fold, Commit) and lisp/src/core.lisp.

gen.description: The line's generation, above every one recorded before it.

id.description: The item the line writes (promote, supersede, contest) or acts on (forget: the forget record; scope): 12 hex.

of.description: The item a supersede replaces or a contest stands against.

key.description: What items are matched by (core.NormKey): a rule's subject, a curated memory's name, else the text.

text.description: The item's text, redacted (contracts/secrets.md); a lesson's stripped of its values.

scope.description: user, global, or project:<repoId, else work-tree root>.

via.description: The evidence: quote (the user's words), request (a plan under a request the person typed), roots (two evidence roots), fast (the same item with new roots), projects (a lesson seen in two projects), edit (a shared curated edit).

roots.description: The evidence roots (sha256 hex), deduplicated: what support counts, never sessions.

record.description: The session record (or curated memory name) the item came from.

tombstones.description: A forget's ids: core items and session records, never text.

base.description: The generation the writer had read through (its consumed-through marker).

model.description: The session model's key (provider/id), for the per-model hint.
